data.name: UrbexCAM
data.detailed_description: UrbexCAM is a first-person horror exploration game where you and your friends break into eerie, abandoned locations - whether it’s a crumbling house, a shutdown mall, or a forgotten factory - to dig up the dark secrets behind why they were left behind. Each place has its own disturbing story, and it’s up to you to piece together the truth. But you’ll need to be careful - this isn’t just some casual walk in the dark. Try to stay silent and out of sight, because these places are rigged with hidden security cameras, motion sensors, traps, and alarms. One wrong move could alert the cops - or something even worse.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain depictions of deceased individuals, including victims of accidents, overdoses, or other tragic events found in abandoned locations. Players may encounter unsettling scenes and environmental storytelling involving death, decay, and themes of substance abuse. No explicit gore, dismemberment, or sexual content is present.
